title: Teach a model to call my tools
blurb: Give it conversations that end in a tool call -- ml-stack-train-tools makes them from your tool schemas, or from what a model actually called on a bench run -- and a chat model learns which tool a question wants and how to call it. A small base is fine-tuned whole; anything bigger takes a LoRA.

e4b.note: 8.0B raw, ~4B active; a full fine-tune of it needs ~128G of optimizer state, so this size is the LoRA path. Defaults sized for a 128 GB unified-memory Mac.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: How long to train
fields.help: A few hundred steps over a few hundred conversations is a pass or two. Watch the held-out score. One pass over 4,000 harvested turns at batch 4 is 1,000 steps.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Longest conversation it reads
fields.help: Tokens. The tool declarations are rendered into every row: the five graph tools with their worked examples measured 1,080 tokens through functiongemma's template, and a row the context cuts off is dropped, not taught.

fields.name: learning_rate
fields.label: Learning rate
fields.help: A full fine-tune of a pretrained model wants a small one; 3e-3 is for training from scratch, and a LoRA wants about 1e-4 because only the adapter moves.

fields.name: lora
fields.label: Train an adapter instead of every weight
fields.help: Two small matrices on each projection, the base frozen: ~0.5% of the weights train, and an 8B model fits where a full fine-tune of it would need ~128G of optimizer state. Needs peft: pip install 'ml-stack[train-lora]'.

fields.name: lora_rank
fields.label: Adapter rank
fields.help: How much the adapter can express, and what it costs. 16 is the usual answer for teaching a format and a habit; 64 is for teaching new knowledge, which this is not.

fields.name: lora_alpha
fields.label: Adapter scale
fields.help: The adapter's update is scaled by alpha/rank, so alpha = 2 x rank keeps that scale at 2 whatever the rank is.

fields.name: lora_targets
fields.label: Which projections get an adapter
fields.help: Comma-separated module names; empty means q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj,gate_proj,up_proj,down_proj -- attention and MLP both, because a tool caller is being taught what to say and not only what to attend to.
